notes: IMDUSD in src/IMDUSD.sol is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named imdUsd with symbol IMDUSD and 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. The pool uses the specified pair token and a 0.3% fee. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), expressed with IMDUSD as currency0. The deployer derives the actual opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply using the deployed currency ordering.
